title: Financial due diligence – draft quality of earnings

paragraphs.text: We agree FY2025 restated revenue of EUR 88m to the audited accounts.

Management's 80% (EUR 70.4m of EUR 88m) counts subscription, support, and the implementation and training fees billed in first-year subscription invoices as recurring. We classify the implementation and training fees (EUR 8m) as non-recurring, leaving EUR 62.4m, or 71% of revenue.

facts.basis: implementation and training fees treated as non-recurring

paragraphs.text: We do not accept EUR 2.5m of pro forma cost savings from a planned office consolidation that has not started. Our adjusted EBITDA is EUR 21.5m. Bridge: EUR 26m (first IM) to EUR 24m after the hardware restatement to EUR 21.5m after excluding the unstarted savings.

facts.basis: adviser-adjusted, excludes unexecuted pro forma savings

paragraphs.text: Cash conversion (operating cash flow over adjusted EBITDA) was 84% in FY2025.
This is a draft; figures may change before the final report.
